text: I ordered via M-Now because the app promised delivery in 30 minutes. It has been over 2 hours and the tracking still says 'packing'. I needed this shirt for an event tonight. What is the point of M-Now if it is slower than normal delivery?
I received a completely different product. I ordered a black hoodie and got a beige sweatshirt from another brand. The return request says 'item mismatch, under review'.

My return was picked up on 28 October but the refund is still showing 'initiated'. It has been more than two weeks. Every time I contact support I get the same copy-paste reply asking me to wait 5-7 days.
The app crashes every time I open the Returns section after the latest update. I can't raise a return for an item and the return window closes in 2 days.
M-Now pe order kiya tha, 30 min bola tha but 1.5 ghante ho gaye. Delivery partner ka location 40 min se same jagah pe hai. Ab cancel bhi nahi ho raha. Bahut bekar experience.
Ordered size M jeans as per the size chart, but the waist is clearly smaller than the chart says. This is the second brand on Myntra where the size chart doesn't match the product.
Return pickup ho gaya 12 din pehle, refund abhi tak bank mein nahi aaya. Customer care bolta hai process ho raha hai. Itna time kyun lagta hai? Next time se Myntra se order nahi karunga.
Third time this month my M-Now order was late. Today it showed 'arriving in 10 mins' for almost an hour. I'm seriously considering going back to Blinkit for quick fashion orders.
Payment ho gaya, paisa account se kat gaya, but app mein order dikh hi nahi raha. Order history khali hai. Please check karo, dobara order karne se darr lag raha hai.
Size chart ke hisaab se L liya tha but shirt bahut tight hai, M jaisa lag raha hai. Exchange ke liye bola to bol rahe hain size available nahi hai. Ab sirf return ka option hai.
Order mein blue colour tha, aaya green. Return pickup wale ne bola tag hata hua hai isliye nahi le sakte, jabki tag maine hataya hi nahi. Ab kya karun?
I chose refund to the original payment method (credit card), but the refund went to Myntra credit instead. I never asked for that. Please reverse it and send the money to my card.
Coupon shows as applied on the cart page but the discount disappears on the payment page. Tried three times. Ended up abandoning the cart.
Package arrived with only one item instead of two. The invoice lists both. Support asked me for an unboxing video which I didn't record. I think that's unfair to expect from customers.
Mera M-Now order auto-cancel ho gaya bina bataye, aur paise abhi tak wallet mein nahi aaye. Agar fast delivery nahi kar sakte to option hi mat dikhao.
The 'Fits true to size' tag on this kurta is misleading. Most reviews say it runs small, and mine did too. Please fix the fit info, I have returned 3 items this month because of size.
Size filter doesn't work properly. I select size 32 and the results still show items that are out of stock in 32. Wasting a lot of time scrolling.
Refund amount is less than what I paid. I was charged a convenience fee and it was not refunded when I returned the item. Nobody explained this before I placed the order.
The watch I received looks used: scratches on the glass and the box was already opened. For a product listed as new this is unacceptable.
Shoes ka size UK 9 order kiya, jo aaya wo bilkul chhota hai. Har brand ka size alag hai, koi proper size guide nahi hai. Return karna pada, time waste.
